priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Preserve the polling timer handle and clear it
findings.body: Every call now creates an interval that cannot be stopped. Disposed pollers continue invoking refresh indefinitely, repeated start-stop cycles accumulate work, and in Node.js the referenced interval can prevent the process from exiting.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener when disposing an attachment
findings.body: When the disposer is called while the socket remains alive, the handler stays registered and continues receiving messages. Repeated attach/dispose cycles accumulate retained callbacks, causing duplicate work, stale-state side effects, and unbounded listener/closure retention.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 returns a no-op disposer immediately after registering handler with socket.on; the full diff confirms this PR removed socket.off("message", handler), so disposal still leaves the listener active.
